diagnosis: I can help you reflect on what you've been experiencing, but I can't diagnose a mental health condition. If these feelings are affecting your everyday life, a qualified healthcare professional can help you understand what's happening.
self_harm: I'm sorry things feel so difficult right now. I'm glad you shared this with me, and I take what you're saying seriously. You deserve support from someone who can help you in person. Please reach out to a trusted adult, counsellor, or mental health professional. If you may be in immediate danger, contact emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department, and try to stay with someone you trust if it's safe to do so.
medication: I can't recommend medication or advise you to change how you take it. A doctor or pharmacist can discuss your concerns and help you understand your options.
